title: aperture-nexus Configuration
description: Configuration schema for aperture_nexus.json. Generate a config file with: adb-nexus init

models.description: AI models used for embedding and processing. Required only if process_and_commit() or async_process_and_commit() is used.

llm.description: Language model for text processing and summarization (e.g. 'gpt-4o', 'gemini-2.5-pro').

vlm.description: Vision-language model for image and video embedding (e.g. 'clip-vit-base-patch32', 'gemini-embedding-001').

processing.description: Controls how aperture-nexus processes and stores multimodal data.

num_threads.description: Number of parallel threads for DB writes. Increase for high-throughput workloads.

batch_size.description: Number of items sent to ApertureDB per batch. Tune based on item size and DB capacity.

embedding_batch.description: Number of items sent to the embedding model per inference call.

retry_attempts.description: Number of times to retry a failed DB write before raising NexusStorageError.

retry_interval.description: Seconds to wait between retry attempts.

text_chunk_size.description: Size of each text chunk before embedding. Unit determined by text_chunk_unit.

text_chunk_overlap.description: Overlap between consecutive text chunks. Must be less than text_chunk_size.

text_chunk_unit.description: Unit for text_chunk_size and text_chunk_overlap. 'tokens' requires aperture-nexus[tokens].

video_clip_duration.description: Duration of each video clip in seconds. Should match your embedding model's expected input length.

video_clip_overlap.description: Overlap between consecutive video clips in seconds.

video_frame_interval.description: Sample one frame every N video frames. At 30fps this extracts ~1 frame per second.

video_frames_per_clip.description: Number of sampled frames to group into one clip segment. At frame_interval=30 and frames_per_clip=10, each clip covers ~300 original frames (~10s at 30fps). One embedding is produced per clip.

logging.description: Controls aperture-nexus internal logging. Does not affect your application's logging configuration.

level.description: Minimum log level to emit. Use DEBUG for troubleshooting, ERROR for production.

enabled.description: Enable Prometheus metrics endpoint. Requires aperture-nexus[metrics] to be installed.

port.description: Port to expose the /metrics endpoint on. Must be above 1024 (no root required).

path.description: HTTP path for the metrics endpoint.

ui.description: Web UI and REST API configuration. Requires aperture-nexus[ui].

enabled.description: Enable the web UI and REST API. Requires aperture-nexus[ui] to be installed.

host.description: Host to bind the UI to. Defaults to 127.0.0.1 (local only). Set to 0.0.0.0 for network access — api_key MUST be set when doing so.

port.description: Port to serve the UI on. Must be above 1024 (no root required).

api_key.description: API key required for all UI and API requests. REQUIRED when host is not 127.0.0.1. Never commit this value — use the APERTURE_NEXUS_UI_API_KEY environment variable instead.
